_comment: Multi-scene config for phase1_qwen_multistep_config.py. Add scenes freely. Each object needs a matching sketch in sketch_dir.

scenes.scene_prompt: A minimalist living room with smooth hardwood parquet floors, matte white painted walls, one large rectangular window on the far wall with soft natural daylight. High ceilings. Completely empty room, no furniture, no objects. Photorealistic architectural interior photography, 4K.

objects.name: bicycle
objects.add_prompt: Picture 1 shows a room. Picture 2 shows a yellow mountain bicycle. Place the bicycle from Picture 2 into the room in Picture 1. Lean it against the right wall. Add a realistic contact shadow on the floor. Do not change any other part of the room.

objects.name: vase
objects.description: black ceramic vase with white flowers
objects.add_prompt: Picture 1 shows a room. Picture 2 shows a black ceramic vase with white flowers. Place the vase from Picture 2 on the wooden floor in the left corner of the room in Picture 1. Add a soft contact shadow. Do not change any other part of the room.

objects.name: ball
objects.add_prompt: Picture 1 shows a room. Picture 2 shows a yellow rubber ball. Place the ball from Picture 2 on the wooden floor near the center of Picture 1. Add a realistic contact shadow. Do not change any other part of the room.
